User: Can you explain the difference between a CPU and a GPU?
Assistant: A CPU (Central Processing Unit) is like the brain of the computer, handling a few complex tasks at once. A GPU (Graphics Processing Unit) is like thousands of tiny hands, handling many simple tasks—like matrix multiplications for AIML—all at the same time.
